narrative:
COGS planning models SEK 22.9B of cost of goods. Budget gross margin is 20.8%.

Materials & Subcontractors (Engines, Avionics, Structures) is the largest cost line at 56% of COGS, driven by bill of material per airframe × deliveries + subcontract work packages. Cost drivers are linked to the volume forecast so they flex with the net sales plan.

signals.title: Engineering hours, not demand, cap FY2027 revenue — 310 FTE gap at Linköping
signals.source: SDP Engineering Capacity — hours demand from the S&OP plan vs available hours
signals.excerpt: The rate ramp-up needs about 9% more engineering and production hours in FY2027. At current hiring pace Linköping is about 310 FTE short from Q2 2027, which would hold back about SEK 1.1B of revenue.

signals.title: SEK/USD at 0.095 — hedge book covers 78% of FY2026 USD purchases
signals.source: SDP Cost Drivers — FX exposure on engines and avionics
signals.excerpt: About a third of materials are bought in USD (engines, avionics). The hedge book covers 78% of FY2026 exposure; a 5% weaker krona on the open 22% costs about SEK 95M of gross profit.
